title: 4D Chicago Style Library Module
description: One architectural style, one file: data/styles/<id>.json, where <id> is the style id a summary record's `style` names (data/summary.schema.json). The Inspect app's Design tab (T-2641, T-2642) shows the module's name, its one-line description, four 'how to spot it' cues and a credited reference plate, exactly as written, so tools/compile_styles.py --check refuses, beyond this schema: a fact (the description, each cue, the plate's attribution) with no grade; an attested fact with no source; an inferred or reconstructed fact with no note; a source id that does not resolve in data/sources/; a cue over 4 words or an explainer over 15; a description over 20 words or a comparison over 8; a plate whose source is not public domain, cleared or free of known restrictions (AGENTS.md hard rule 6), whose file is not committed under assets/plates/styles/ with an entry in assets/LICENSES.md, or whose sha256 does not match; a plate building that does not stand in the plate's scene; a missing plate with no `plate_gap` saying why; and an id, snake_case word, file path, link or ticket number in anything a visitor reads (the summary records' lint, imported).

text.description: Shown to a visitor exactly as written.

sources.description: Source ids in data/sources/. Never invent one.

note.description: The reasoning (inferred) or what bounded the invention (reconstructed). Linted like every visitor string.

id.description: The style id; the file's name.

name.description: The style's name as a visitor reads it.

summary.description: One plain line, at most 20 words: what the style is.

compare.description: At most 8 words, for the Compare styles list.

period.description: The years the cited guide gives the style.

cues.description: Exactly four 'how to spot it' cues.

plate.description: The reference plate, or null with `plate_gap` saying why none is cleared yet.

file.description: Path under assets/. Data, never shown.

source.description: The image's own source record, whose rights_status must allow display.

caption.description: At most 15 words: what and when.

credit.description: Who made it and who holds it, as a visitor reads it.

building.description: The structure id, where the building stands in one of the project's scenes. Data, never shown.

display_crop.description: Optional [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions of the image, for a plate that is a whole page. Approximate; the Design tab may refine it.

shows_style.description: The claim that this building is of this style.

plate_gap.description: Required when `plate` is null: why no plate is cleared yet, and what would clear one.
